vetSays.line: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — two knobs on glass-still water, watching: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Kwame, Salvador, Jamie and Emma met them at the door — 4 put down. Kwame, Salvador, Jamie, Emma are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nightlight: Never wade in. The glow is a mouth — it waits for you to come close. Never wade in. Strike the light from two squares out and it's just a fish with a lamp. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Loud: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Choir Toad: Break the chorus. The Resonant Croak needs the chorus — every throat in range joins. SHOUT and the note dies mid-croak. The hum needs the choir; scatter the choir. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
🛡️ Jamie, Roman, Boris, Emma and Devon met them at the door — 5 put down. Jamie, Roman, Boris, Emma, Devon are hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Extended Warranty: Never stand still. The RING is the telegraph — the pitch itself gives no warning. Move two or more tiles from where you stood when it dialed and the call drops. It can only dial a stationary target. Never stand still. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Bulldozer: Step OFF the lane. When it lowers its head, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back. It can't turn and it never goes around. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. The screen burns brightest just before it fires: that's your two-turn warning. Or break its concentration outright: a stun or shout while the screen burns brightest fizzles the picture. Interruptible — it can only hold one memory at a time. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Ugly Beast: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Bailiff: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Emma lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Loud-Eyes: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Loud-Eyes: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Loud-Eyes: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Leo taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Daniyar showed Xavier the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Leo drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aki just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aki met them at the door — 1 put down. Aki is hurt.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Herald: Read the omens — reposition freely. It announces everything — read the omens. It is slow: reposition freely, never trade blows standing still. (It is a tutorial — the real test comes later. Learn it here, cheap.) (Aki lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunback: Fight from its shadow side. When it arches, move to its SHADOW side — between it and the sun — and don't stand still. The lunge goes where you WERE, and the glare can't touch you from the shade. Strike while it's recharging the scales. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Union Rep: Kill the rep first. It does not fight, it ORGANIZES — kill the rep before WALKOUT or the stomp lands as one. First blood on the rep, every time. Every ally it rallies hits +3 harder. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Grief Counselor: Sidestep the charge. Break line of sight during the mirror beat and the charge dies unspent — or sidestep: it can't turn mid-charge. Don't look at the reflection. Look at its feet — they tell you where it's going. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ines just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish. Every uninterrupted turn is a loaded bite. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Ugly: Contradict the narration. It is a STORY and stories need listeners — it narrates you faltering, and the verses count down. Contradict it with your actions: it says you run, you advance. Three true contradictions and the story dismisses you kindly. (It says you falter — do not.) (Ellis lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Loud Beast: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (Akif lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🛡️ Akif, Ellis and Priya met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Akif, Ellis, Priya are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Akif just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Audit: Be inefficient on purpose. It taxes your best trick on audit day — read the clipboard, know the schedule, and front-load everything between the announced rounds. When the auditors come, be deliberately, visibly inefficient: it cannot tax what does not optimize. (Akif lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Loud Beast: Do something you have never done. It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. Do something you have never done and it has nothing to wear. Novelty is literally the weapon; repetition is the uniform it dresses you in. (Ellis lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Big: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (Anyela lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Bailiff (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Big: Leave. Navigation is victory. You cannot kill a suburb — the fight is a timer and the Property Tax is the clock. LEAVE. Navigation is victory. (If you must stay: bring the wild inside — a plant, a stray, a rumor — it is sterile and it cannot cope.) (Hassan lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Anyela just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Redactor: Go quiet — starve the redaction. It redacts the loudest thing first, and the handles point a full round before the redaction lands. Go quiet for two turns and its attacks come thin; a third quiet turn starves it out of the fight. (Striking feeds it — every wound gets un-written.) (Anyela lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)
